title: Duck Noodle Stir Fry
description: A quick and flavorful stir fry made with duck, noodles, and a hint of Russian spice.
instructions: Cook the noodles according to package instructions.
Heat sesame oil in a pan over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced duck breast and cook until browned and cooked through.
Add the cooked noodles to the pan and stir in the zesty sauce.
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes until the sauce is bubbly and the noodles are well coated.
